steps.title: Drops wise we are ideally after …
steps.text: Drops wise we are ideally after 4 Zenyte Shards & 3 Tormented Synapses. On drop rate and including all other tasks, we will probably see 87 Slayer at this point. Continue to 92 if you are rushing Noxious Halberd. Once you have all 4 Zenytes & 3 Tormented Synapses we can leave slayer for a while.

steps.title: You will need 74 Fletching for …
steps.text: You will need 74 Fletching for Scorching Bow. If you bought Broader Fletching you can make Broad Arrows until 74 which are very fast. Cut Maple Logs while farming Seaweed Spores and then make them Headless + Broad while doing Fishing Trawler for Angler Outfit (Tempoross Combat Achievement).
